name: Music March
tagline: An audio visualiser that raises ray-marched infinite terrain to the bass, mids and treble.

awards: Huawei Custom Challenge #1: Interactive Landscape Graphics

problem: The team wanted to extend the sponsor's terrain-rendering challenge into something interactive.
solution: Frequency analysis of incoming audio drives the height map of procedurally generated hills in a rewritten fragment shader; users can fly through the scene.
demo_moment: Team-described: play music and watch the landscape pulse.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Huawei Custom Challenge #1: Interactive Landscape Graphics” among 217 submissions.
Rewrote the provided shader rather than tuning it.

lessons: Add a sensory hook to a technical challenge so judges feel the result.
